# Bursar — llms.txt

Bursar: invoicing + receivables for AI-agent commerce on Tempo (Colosseum World's Fair, Tempo track).

## Contracts (Tempo Moderato testnet, chain 42431)
- Registry v2 `0xC3FA070c45F1bDbA8871171F5c950f8C89c0fce1`: `createInvoiceWithId(bytes32,buyer,token,amount)`, `markPaid(bytes32,txHash)`, `getInvoice(bytes32)`. Verified on contracts.tempo.xyz. Non-custodial: never holds funds.
- Registry v1 `0xe138ED601fb64181cF38987a13bfbC94Fcf51066` (superseded).
- Test pathUSD `0x20c0000000000000000000000000000000000000` (6 decimals). Faucet: `tempo_fundAddress` RPC.
- Key primitive: TIP-20 `transferWithMemo(to, amount, memo: bytes32)` emits `TransferWithMemo(from,to,value,memo)` (memo indexed) — the join key for all reconciliation.

## Live endpoints
- Merchant: `GET /api/price` → 402 challenge | retry with receipt → 200 data.
- Books: `GET /api/invoices` (chain-derived). Export: `GET /api/export` (auditor view key).
- Dashboard + threat model + integration guide in repo: `dashboard/`, `docs/THREAT_MODEL.md`, `docs/INTEGRATE.md`.

## Docs
- https://docs.tempo.xyz/llms.txt (Tempo developer index)
- https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/guide/machine-payments/ (MPP charge + session)
- https://tempo.xyz/developers/docs/guide/payments/transfer-memos (bytes32 memos)
